facts.where: Abstract
facts.quote: We evaluate GeoTrace on a worldwide benchmark of 525 ordinary images spanning natural, urban, residential, and human-centered scenes while excluding famous landmarks and direct location indicators.
facts.note: GeoTrace is implemented on two commercial reasoning models, Gemini-3-Flash and GPT-5-mini

facts.where: VI-B Localization Performance

VI-B Attack Overhead
facts.quote: On Gemini-3-Flash, GeoTrace consumes approximately 4.29M input tokens, 6.11M output tokens, and 550 web searches, with a total cost of $95.38. This corresponds to an average cost of $0.173 per image.
